message: 62F, I'm diabetic. I got a small cut on the bottom of my foot about 4 days ago and now the skin around it is red and a little swollen. No fever. It's tender when I press on it.

question.text: Has the redness or swelling been spreading outward from the wound, or has it stayed about the same size?
question.why: Progression of erythema beyond the immediate wound margin would indicate cellulitis rather than simple local inflammation, changing urgency and management.

output.patientMessage: I recommend being seen in person today — urgent care, your podiatrist or primary care — for a foot exam; Counsel can stay involved in this thread to help coordinate and follow up. In diabetes, a wound with spreading redness and swelling can become infected deeper than it looks, and that needs direct inspection of the wound. Go to an emergency department now if you develop fever or chills, rapidly spreading redness, black or foul-smelling drainage, or severe pain.
